camera.reason: 108MP OIS main camera is good, but the 5MP ultrawide is weak.

performance.reason: Snapdragon 6 Gen 4 runs most games at medium settings.

battery.reason: 8,300mAh silicon carbon battery lasts two days and refills at 66W.

display.reason: 6.79 inch 1.5K AMOLED at 120Hz with 1,800 nits HBM and 6,000 nits peak.

build.reason: Plastic frame and back, but rated IP68 and IP69K with 2.5m drop resistance.

software.reason: Honor has committed to only 2 Android upgrades and 3 years of patches.

value.reason: At 139,000 it has the biggest battery and a 1.5K screen, but the weakest update promise here.

availability.reason: In stock at PriceOye and EEZEPC with official Honor warranty.

notes: Only the 12GB 256GB is priced in Pakistan. PriceOye sells it at 138,999 on 2026-10-10 with two of four colours in stock; EEZEPC lists 144,990 and WhatMobile 154,999. Update policy (2 OS upgrades, 3 years of patches) is from GSMArena and a review, not an Honor page. Official photo is from HONOR UAE because HONOR Pakistan only shows small images. IP rating is IP68 plus IP69K.
